LABUAN FINANCIAL SERVICES AUTHORITY ACT 1996

LABUAN FINANCIAL SERVICES AUTHORITY (PROCESSING AND APPROVAL FEES)
(LABUAN FINANCIAL INSTITUTIONS) (AMENDMENT) ORDER 2022

Labuan Financial Services Authority Act 1996 [ Act 545 ], the Authority,
with the approval of the Minister makes the following order:

(Processing and Approval Fees) (Labuan Financial Institutions) (Amendment)
Order 2022.

 (2) This Order comes into operation on 1 January 2023.
